purpose: Final assembled production-renderer gallery after all detachable modules are integrated and visually accepted. Body-only Blender QA images must not be copied as final weapon photographs.

workshop.notes: Use the complete default catalog tree and no exploded parts. Existing review page currently resets distance to 1.35 each frame; capture implementation must intentionally support this recipe's distances. Wait for all relevant groups to load and confirm zero model errors before capture.

firstPerson.notes: Use the existing live world/player equipment and Renderer.raid path; do not fabricate FP by moving the workshop camera. Capture idle and, for QA, existing reload/swap at progress 0.25, 0.5, 0.75. Actual game runtime owns bolt, recoil and magazine poses.

acceptance: Both sides and top show continuous physical support for sights, controls and interfaces.
Default magazine/stock/guard/grip/muzzle models sit in their sockets without duplicate body geometry.
Textures, normal directions, material response and silhouettes remain readable in the actual game renderer.
FP and ADS show usable sight line and hand contact; reload does not split static body parts.
Record actual screenshots and per-platform status; do not substitute Blender structural PASS for gameplay or visual acceptance.
